## Description and Rationale

I'm a technology leader who enjoys working with messy, real-world operational data and turning it into solid models and pipelines. As to why I joined, I just love a good challenge. especially one like this that will likely require models that aren't necessarily traditional. Ground operations have so many dynamic moving parts, and exploring creative, non-standard approaches to predict taxi-out times is exactly the kind of puzzle I enjoy tackling.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Egypt

library(gt)
